key_highlights: ASX set for sharp selloff following Wall Street plunge into correction territory triggered by tech and AI declines
Domestic market reels from $169B weekly wipeout amid severe flash PMI contraction into recession territory
Short positioning on AUD hits record velocity as domestic growth and property headwinds intensify
Severe household and retail distress evidenced by rapid Sydney property drops and David Jones restructuring

sectors.trend: Bifurcation between resilient gold/critical minerals exploration and macro-sensitive bulk commodities.
sectors.implications: Strong risk-off bidding for domestic gold restarts and high-grade recovery discoveries; caution on bulk miners facing global demand weakness.

sectors.trend: Severe valuation derating tracking US AI selloff and tighter capital raising scrutiny.
sectors.implications: High-multiple ASX tech names face multiple compression and capital constraints; hiring freezes reflect enterprise software caution.

sectors.trend: Mounting balance sheet stress driven by cumulative RBA rate hikes and plunging dwelling prices.
sectors.implications: Net interest margin compression, slower credit growth, and rising bad debt provisioning threaten major bank return on equity.

sectors.trend: Accelerating structural distress and aggressive competitive discounting among department stores and discretionary retailers.
sectors.implications: Margin contraction and sales contraction across discretionary retail; market share consolidation toward agile players like Myer.

sectors.trend: Defensive stability tempered by government price controls on PBS medicines through 2030.
sectors.implications: Margin caps on subsidized pharmaceuticals, offset by non-cyclical defensive cash flows and ongoing demand for core therapies.

key_themes: Global tech valuation de-rating and equity market contagion
Australian macroeconomic contraction with PMI entering recession levels
Extreme speculative shorting of the Australian Dollar
Severe mortgage holder exhaustion and residential property declines
Flight to safe-haven assets and gold exploration plays

risk_assessment.risk_factor: Global Equity Market Contagion & AI Valuation Unwind
risk_assessment.mitigation: Reduce portfolio beta, trim high-multiple tech holdings, and increase cash or inverse ETF coverage.
Overweight defensive non-cyclical sectors such as healthcare and utilities while avoiding discretionary retail.

risk_assessment.risk_factor: Residential Property Deflation & Mortgage Book Stress
risk_assessment.mitigation: Underweight major retail banks with heavy domestic mortgage concentrations (CBA, WBC, NAB, ANZ).
Hold unhedged offshore earnings and USD-denominated commodity producers.

opportunities.rationale: Gold serves as primary safe haven amid market correction, recession fears, and active project restarts.

opportunities.recommendation: Selective Exposure to High-Grade Critical Minerals
opportunities.rationale: High metallurgical recovery breakthroughs and strategic management appointments drive idiosyncratic small-cap gains.
Extreme short positioning on AUD provides translated earnings tailwinds for multinational resource and healthcare leaders.

defensive_moves.recommendation: Hedge Core Equity Portfolios Against Index Drawdowns
defensive_moves.rationale: ASX facing steep losses after $169B wipeout and US correction spillover.
Significant borrowing capacity reduction and accelerated Sydney home price declines elevate credit risk.

defensive_moves.recommendation: Divest Discretionary Retail and High-Beta Tech
defensive_moves.rationale: Mass layoffs, consumer spending retrenchment, and tech sector multiple compression.

market_outlook.short_term: Bearish over 1–3 months. Broad equity market faces downside pressure from Wall Street correction, negative flash PMI data, and acute housing drag.
market_outlook.long_term: Cautiously neutral over 6–12 months. Stabilization will depend on RBA policy easing, labor market resilience, and a bottoming in property prices.
key_catalysts: RBA Board interest rate decision and post-meeting statement
Upcoming Australian quarterly GDP and CPI releases
US Federal Reserve monetary trajectory and Big Tech quarterly earnings
Monthly building approvals and CoreLogic residential dwelling index data
Flash PMI follow-ups and business confidence survey results

Australian 3-year and 10-year government bond yield spreads
Major bank 90+ day mortgage delinquency rates
Spot gold (XAU/USD) and iron ore (62% Fe CFR Qingdao) prices
